story: Stage 3 of the Vuelta a Andalucia Ruta Ciclista Del Sol saw a four-rider breakaway from the start, but the peloton caught them in with 15 km remaining. The race ended in a bunch sprint won by Milan Fretin ahead of Paul Penhoët and Christophe Laporte.
